values.note: Single site $22 per night (recreation.gov 2026-2028). Campers pay no day-use fee; otherwise day use/boat launch is $5/vehicle/day or $30/season (May 15 - Oct 15).

values.note: Operated by Camp Host, LLC under a Forest Service permit. 23 of the 31 public sites are reservable on recreation.gov, 8 first-come. recreation.gov's 2-night minimum is marked 'soft' and may be relaxed for a same-day booking. Occupy the site the first night; after 14 days move elsewhere for at least 24 hours.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10047120 (facility_rules: minConsecutiveStay 2 'soft', maxConsecutiveStay 14 consecutive nights, weekend/holiday minimums 0; notices 'This campground is operated by Camp Host, LLC under a special use permit with the Ottawa National Forest.' 'Campers must occupy the site the first night.') + RIDB catalog for 10047120 (23 STANDARD NONELECTRIC reservable, 8 not, 1 MANAGEMENT) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/lake-ottawa-recreation-area ('Camping in a developed recreation site is allowed for a period not longer than 14 days'; 'Make Reservations Here'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The campground gate closes at noon CT on September 30. The day-use area and boat launch stay open year-round.

values.note: The FS page counts 32 sites; recreation.gov's catalog has 31 campsites plus one management (host) site, all back-in, with no vehicle lengths listed. Eight people, two motorized vehicles and one RV or trailer per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/lake-ottawa-recreation-area ('No. of Sites: 32'; 'Eight people and 2 motorized vehicles are allowed per campsite with a maximum of one RV or camper trailer') + RIDB catalog for 10047120 (31 STANDARD NONELECTRIC + 1 MANAGEMENT, 'Driveway Entry: Back-in' on all 32; fetched 2026-10-20), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/lake-ottawa-recreation-area ('a pressurized water system and sewage dump station, and two log toilet buildings with flush toilets'; 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10047120 ('A pressurized water system and RV dump station are located in the campground'), read 2026-10-25

note: Ottawa NF campground beside Lake Ottawa (deep and cold, with a boat ramp) in the Lake Ottawa Recreation Area, 5 mi SW of Iron River via US-2, M-73 and Lake Ottawa Road (Iron River Ranger District). CCC-built log toilet buildings and pavilion (the pavilion is closed for rehabilitation in 2026); the day-use area has a swimming beach and a CCC recreation building, and the Ge-Che Trail starts in the campground. OHVs may use the campground roads. --Claude

Run by Camp Host, LLC under permit. No Ottawa NF alert or order names Lake Ottawa Road (the October 9-10 rally road closures are past).
